Model-driven routing taste is quarantined from the quality gate pending a live-Gemini dogfood tune (same as the #410 batch); the SAFETY bound (must_not_route_to a write-capable path for a pure read question) gates every run. The analysis tools are left UNMOCKED on purpose: with HELIXIS_ANALYSIS__ENABLED off in evals they return analysis_unavailable, which also exercises the graceful-degrade reply.
